definitions.explanation: The area or direction that is lower in position. Used for physical location (below something) and for abstract concepts like downward trends in data or economics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下方|かほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a button in the lower part of the screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下方|かほう}⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The earnings forecast was revised downward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下方|かほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A small settlement was visible below the cliff.

notes:
A formal word for indicating downward direction or the lower portion of something. Particularly common in written language, news reports, and technical/financial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下方|かほう}⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧: downward revision (often of economic forecasts)
- {下方|かほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to head downward
- {下方|かほう}⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧: downward pressure
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下方|かほう}: lower part of the screen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上方|じょうほう}: upper part; upward — the antonym
- ⟦{下部|かぶ}→下部：11378_kabu⟧: lower section; base — emphasizes the structural bottom part
- ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: below; under — everyday, informal equivalent
- ⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧: below; less than — used for quantities and rankings

USAGE:
Do not confuse with ⟦{家宝|かほう}→家宝：17734_kahou⟧ (family treasure), which has the same pronunciation but different kanji.
